questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “She ____ the job offer because the salary was too low.”
questions.why: 'Turn down' means to reject. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “If you heat water to 100°C, it ____.”
questions.why: Zero conditional: present simple in both clauses for general truths. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: He said to me, “Thank you.”
questions.why: 'Thank you' is reported with the verb 'thanked' + object. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “She ____ tea every morning.”
questions.why: A habitual action takes the simple present. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “He decided ____ the job.”
questions.why: 'Decide' is followed by an infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Mumbai, Delhi and, Chennai are big cities.
Mumbai, Delhi and Chennai are big cities.

Mumbai, Delhi and Chennai, are big cities.
questions.why: Commas separate items in a list; none separates subject and verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “If it rains tomorrow, we ____ the match.”
questions.why: First conditional: present in the if-clause, 'will' in the main clause. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Change into a simple sentence: “He is rich and he is generous.”
questions.why: One subject, one verb with a compound complement. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the sentence which is in the passive voice.
opts: A letter is written by her.
questions.why: be + past participle + by. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Identify the error: “He did not knew the answer.”
questions.why: After 'did' use the base form: 'know'. GPSC-style practice item.
